question: Will the IOM Missing Migrants Project record at least 900 Mediterranean migrant deaths in 2026 before April 2026?
summary: Hitting 900 deaths by end-March requires March fatalities of about 294, well above the typical 180–210 monthly rate, given 606 deaths by late February.
The February–March pace is elevated but still uncertain; a March toll that large is plausible but not highly likely.
Objections highlight downward pressures from SAR improvements and provisional revisions, while also noting upward revisions could occur; net effect is uncertain.
The ensemble aggregate (~49%) is slightly optimistic relative to the need for an unusually deadly March, warranting a modest downward calibration.

justification.adjustment: Adjusted from 0.49 to 0.45 to reflect the low probability of a March toll reaching 294 above the already elevated pace, given typical monthly rates and ongoing uncertainties.
